The '''sil-ar''' were the most common race among the [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] [[Tiss'shar/Legends|Tiss'shar]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. They had diamond shaped markings on the backs of their heads and torsos, and on their limbs.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies">''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]''</ref>
